title: Concept: Conda environment that installs a pip dependency from git
description: environment.yml declares a `pip:` entry with a `git+` URL, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `pip:` entry with a `git+` URL.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through environment.yml (conda).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a `pip:` entry with a `git+` URL.
